## The problem

People making career decisions need understandable information about how technology may affect different occupations. CareerShield AI provides a way to explore those predictions across more than 500 careers.

## My approach

I built a full-stack application that processes career data with PySpark on Databricks, trains a predictive model, and presents the results in interactive dashboards. The application uses FastAPI for the backend and React for the user interface.

## The work

The project combined data processing, predictive modeling, and application development. I used Python and scikit-learn for the machine-learning workflow, PySpark and Databricks for processing, and FastAPI and React to make the results available through an interactive application.

## The result

CareerShield AI predicts technology impact across 500+ careers, and the model achieved 94.7% accuracy on the evaluation used for the project.
